integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A cinematic wide shot of an old fisherman in a yellow oilskin coat standing on a weathered wooden pier at dawn, coiling a wet blue rope over his forearm. Mist drifts over the grey harbour water behind him and small moored boats rock gently. The camera holds steady. The rope creaks and water laps against the pilings.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of his weathered hands tying a bowline knot in the blue rope, water dripping from his fingers, shallow depth of field. He says in a low gravelly voice, <d>[English] Steady now.</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a low angle of white gulls wheeling over the harbour against a pale orange sky, the fisherman in his yellow coat a small figure at the end of the pier.

overall_soundscape: Lapping water, creaking wood, distant gull calls and a light sea wind.

non_diegetic_music: none
